crew.overview: The story of the last Seal Child’s journey home. After their mother’s disappearance, Ben and Saoirse are sent to live with Granny in the city. When they resolve to return to their home by the sea, their journey becomes a race against time as they are drawn into a world Ben knows only from his mother’s folktales. But this is no bedtime story; these fairy folk have been in our world far too long. It soon becomes clear to Ben that Saoirse is the key to their survival.
crew.title: Song of the Sea

crew.overview: Adventure awaits 12 year old Brendan who must fight Vikings and a serpent god to find a crystal and complete the legendary Book of Kells. In order to finish Brother Aiden's book, Brendan must overcome his deepest fears on a secret quest that will take him beyond the abbey walls and into the enchanted forest where dangerous mythical creatures hide. Will Brendan succeed in his quest?
crew.title: The Secret of Kells

details.biography: Maya Merigeau studied animation at the Ecole des Métiers du Cinéma d'Animation in Angoulême, France. Since 2004 Merigeau has worked as an animator and background designer at Cartoon Saloon in Kilkenny, Ireland, participating in many feature and short film projects, including Oscar-nominated  The Secret of Kells (2009) and their own directorial debut, Old Fangs (2009).
details.name: Maya Merigeau
